title: Waterwraith roller attacks, Purple vulnerability receiver and cleanup

native.head: 5e42ba1d1ef8a0eb46755265ce0eadd84e615025
native.note: Adds the family combat consumer on top of the register seam. No pc_p2_hardlanes hook change (the register hook from a4526e6a already calls the seam). Native origin/upstream not pushed.

shared_hooks_for_lane_01: CMakeLists.txt: add pc_port/pc_p2_waterwraith_encounter.cpp to the pikmin_pc sources.
pc_p2_waterwraith_register.cpp: register reset also resets the encounter consumer; per-source-tick encounter_step before actor.tick.
pc_p2_waterwraith_register.h: added read-only accessors (wraith/roller position, attached, tyre/body health) for fixtures.
No new pc_p2_hardlanes hook hunk; the a4526e6a register hook is reused.

markers: P2_WATERWRAITH_ENCOUNTER_PASS stuns=1 hits=39 crushes=20 damage=2340.0 zeroed=1 child_removed=1

limitations: The roller crush uses InteractFlick with the resident captain as the acting owner: the source attribution creature is not present on this host actor (the retained-assembly Waterwraith attack callback is out of scope). Tyre fp24 damage 10 and the radii are lane adaptations.
The host death script (dismount -> tyre_getoff -> child removal) and the body Dead key sequence are driven by the encounter inputs; the retained-assembly pathfinder is still not ported.

Purple Pikmin are real squad members converted with pc_p2_make_purple from the staged P2_PURPLE_1 profile (impact disabled); the fixture positions them near the actor. This is a live-squad arena, not a natural cave encounter.
The treasure released on Dead KEYEVENT_5 is logged only; the durable reward/Onion path is lane 06.
